The 8 `world` commands of the editor at engine `319075e3f92b`: each with its description, its kind, the MCP toolsets that offer it, its parameters and their JSON Schema (the other groups have files of their own).

## world.cook

Measures a world's cells for its index, off the frame: per cell its entities, physics bodies, bounds and the stored bytes it loads, and the most bodies the persistent scene's streaming sources can keep loaded anywhere (maxBodiesInRadius); writes them into the world document. Only cells whose files changed since the last cook are read again (cellsRead; cellsReused). Fails, writing nothing, when cells share entity IDs with each other or with the persistent scene (the error names them) or a cell cannot be read. apply (default true): also sets the persistent scene's physics capacity (Physics Capacity &gt; Max Bodies) to the recommended one, 1.25 times maxBodiesInRadius for spawns, when the persistent scene is the edited scene in edit mode when the cook starts and when it ends (otherwise a warning says it was not set; an explicit apply: true then fails, writing nothing). One undo step. Saves in flight are waited for, before the cook and before it writes; when the world document was written during the cook (a save listing new cells), the cook starts again from it. Returns staleBefore (cells measured again), maxBodies (the recommended capacity), seconds, and warnings: cells beyond the 20 km worlds are supported within, empty cells.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:445`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apply` | boolean | no |   | Also set the persistent scene's physics capacity (default true). |
| `world` | string | yes |   | The world (.stworld): handle or path (asset handle, or path relative to the asset directory). |

## world.create

Makes a new world: &lt;path&gt;.stworld and its persistent scene &lt;path&gt;.stscene (the basic3d content, a &quot;World&quot; entity with its WorldComponent; the primary camera streams the cells). Layers default to Terrain, Buildings, Props and Gameplay, each of cellSize meters with a streaming distance of four cells (the first loads before a game starts); give names, or objects {name, cellSize, streamingDistance, enabledByDefault, loadBeforeStart}. open (default true) opens it (failing on unsaved changes unless force; a new history starts, like scene.open; saves in flight are waited for first); without open, one undo step that removes the files. Returns {world, persistentScene, layers}.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:577`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cellSize` | number | no |   | Side of the layers' cells in meters (1-65536, default 64). |
| `force` | boolean | no |   | Go on although the edited scene has unsaved changes, discarding them (default false: the command fails instead). Discarded changes are kept as recovery data of the project (scene.recoveryStatus), and the person at the editor is told who discarded them. |
| `layers` | array | no |   | Layer names, or {name, cellSize, streamingDistance, enabledByDefault, loadBeforeStart}. |
| `open` | boolean | no |   | Open the new world (default true). |
| `path` | string | yes |   | Path relative to the asset directory without extension, e.g. &quot;Worlds/Island&quot;. |

## world.edit

How the editor edits the open world, for the session: editLayer, the layer new top-level entities go into (a layer's name, or &quot;Persistent&quot; for the persistent scene, the default); visibleLayers, the layers it streams (empty: all); radiusScale, a factor of every layer's streaming distance around the editor camera (0.1-10, default 1). Returns world.status.

## world.info

Describes a world: its name, persistent scene and grid origin, its layers (id, name, cell size and streaming distance in meters, whether they stream by default and load before a game starts, their cells), its cells, and its index (cooked: whether it has one; staleCells: cells changed since it was made, which world.cook measures again; maxBodiesInRadius, persistentBodies and the recommended physics capacity). Distant cells are not loaded at all (no low-detail stand-ins): a game sets fog or far planes to match the layers' streaming distances.

## world.loadCells

Loads cells of the open world and keeps them (pinned) until unpinned: cells by key (\[{layer, x, z}\], layer by name or ID) or in a region ({center: \[x, y, z\], radius} or {min: \[x, z\], max: \[x, z\]}, of the given layers or all). pin (default true): false loads them without keeping them (they go when the camera leaves). unpin: cells to let go; unpinAll: let every pinned cell go. wait: answer once the cells are loaded (or failed). Returns {cells: \[{layer, x, z, state, entities}\]}.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:888`

## world.moveEntities

Moves top-level entities of the open world into the cell of a layer at their positions (made when it does not exist yet, written at the next save), or into the persistent scene with layer &quot;Persistent&quot;. Their descendants go with them. One undo step. Fails, changing nothing, for a child entity, an unknown layer or a target cell that is not loaded yet (it is loading then: try again once it is in).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:951`

## world.setLayers

Replaces a world's layer list: adds, renames, reorders and retunes layers (streaming distance, enabledByDefault, loadBeforeStart). Layers are matched to the existing ones by id (objects may give it) or name; a rename moves the layer's cell folder (handles kept). Removing a layer that has cells, or changing the cell size of one, is refused unless deleteCells moves those cells to the trash (never cells loaded in the open world: hide the layer first, world.edit visibleLayers). Waits for saves in flight first (they may write the cells it moves). One undo step.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:670`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## world.status

The world the editor edits (null when the edited scene is no world's persistent scene): its edit layer, visible layers and radius scale (world.edit), the source (the editor camera), its cells' counts (wanted, loading, loaded, unloading, pinned, failed, dirty: changed since saved) and whether the persistent scene is dirty; with cells: true, the cells that are not plain unloaded ones, at most limit (state, entities, dirty, pinned, wanted, error). While playing, playing has the running game's streaming counts.

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Session` · MCP toolsets: `world` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorWorldCommands.cpp:814`
